import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { users } from "./users";

export const friends = defineTable("friends", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        userId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        friendUserId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        createdAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" })
    },
    relations: {
        friendUser: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        user: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
